findings.title: Rank-one commuting resolution is not arbitrary-state tomography or Gauss certification

anchors.text: **Reading, not theorem.** The `SU(2)` conclusion survives verbatim at `N = 3`, and now on a carrier that contains the `SU(3)`-specific singlet channel. The readable-and-physical algebra is the **abelian shadow** of the block: the charges and the link-end flux counts and nothing else. Item 6 and item 8 are the positive half -- inside the physical sector the **record-readable and gauge-invariant** content resolves every state from every other -- and items 4 and 5 the negative half, on the same carriers, at the same time.

1. **For `SU(3)` exactly as for `SU(2)`, the record-readable and gauge-invariant algebra is the abelian record data.** `dim(R n I) = (N+1)^V 2^E`, verified on nine carriers, generated by the charges `Q_v` and the link-end electric Casimirs, colour-blind to a one, and on the Gauss sector a complete commuting set of rank-one projectors: records resolve every physical state from every other and still cannot see colour.

**Reading, not theorem (this register).** For three colours as for two, the records can say everything physical about a coloured system except its colour: only whether its colour count is a multiple of three, and its plain charges and flux counts, can be read off. That is what confinement looks like at the level of registration, and it holds before any dynamics is written.
3. What the triality-zero readable classes support as a bookkeeping of their own, given that they resolve the physical sector completely.

findings.title: Triality zero is not singlet sufficiency; the reported source has triality1, not2

anchors.text: **Conclusion.** (1) The **triality operator** `omega^{Q_v}`, `omega = e^{2 pi i/3}`, is diagonal in the record basis **and** commutes with all sixteen `G_v^a` at `nnz = 0`: it is an element of `R n I`. (2) The **Gauss sector sits entirely at triality zero** -- over its record hull the triality tuple takes only `(0,0)` on the dimer and only `(0,0,0)` on the 3-chain. A colour singlet is exactly a triality-zero set of record patterns. (3) A colour **triplet** at corner `0`: five highest-weight vectors at weight `(1/2, 1/(2 sqrt 3))`; `psi_1` and its partners `psi_2 = G_0^- psi_1`, `psi_3 = V_0^- psi_1` are exact singlets at the other corner to `7.02e-17`, all carry `<C_0> = 1.333333333 = 4/3`, the fundamental `3`, and the identical abelian charge `<Q_0> = 2.200000000`. (4) **Colour-rotated states are maximally distinct in the raw records and identical in every record-readable and gauge-invariant statistic.** `U(theta) = exp(-i theta sum_v G_v^a)` holds the state in `span{psi_1, psi_2, psi_3}` to `1.59e-16` with `|<psi_1|psi_theta>|^2 = 0.882421094 = cos^2(theta/2)` at the declared `theta = 0.7`; the fine record distributions of `psi_1` and its partners are at **total-variation distance `1.000000000000`**, disjoint supports; yet over the `32` atoms of `R n I` the deviation is at most `1.110e-16`, and over the declared scan of **all eight `su(3)` axes `x` five declared angles** at most `1.665e-16`. The same on the 3-chain: fine `TV = 1.000000` across the whole scan, readable deviation `<= 6.939e-17` for the partners and `<= 1.527e-16` for the scan, over `256` atoms. (5) **Every colour multiplet operator has a zero Gauss-sector block**: over `41` of them on the dimer -- sixteen `rho_v^a` and eight `E^a_{e,i}` (**octets**), three `psi_{0,a}` and three `psi^dag_{0,a}` (**triplets** and **anti-triplets**), the global colour charge, and the single colour record values `2 rho_0^3` and `2 E^3_{0,i}` -- `max |P_G T P_G| = 1.081e-16`, and over `42` on the 3-chain `4.484e-16`. The **singlet** readouts `Q_0`, `H_hop`, `sum E^2` and `omega^{Q_0}` instead have blocks of rank `3, 2, 4, 4` of `4` on the dimer and `7, 10, 10` of `10` on the 3-chain. (6) What records **do** register of an uncompensated colour source is the `Z_3` triality charge: `P[Q_0 = k mod 3] = (0, 1, 0)` -- triality `2` with certainty -- identically for `psi_1`, `psi_2`, `psi_3` and `psi_theta`, against `(1, 0, 0)` for a Gauss-sector state, on both carriers. (7) The 3-chain hull contains the **`epsilon_abc` baryon**: `21` of its `78` patterns carry `n^f_0 = 3`, the `SU(3)` singlet channel with no `SU(2)` analogue.

**Reading, not theorem.** This is the sentence the `SU(2)` note could not write, because `Z_2` has no triality-`1` representation: the centre charge here is a genuine three-valued label, it is carried identically by every member of a colour triplet, and the physical sector is exactly its zero level. "The records cannot tell one colour from another" remains **false** as a claim about record patterns -- `TV = 1`, disjoint supports. The true statement is: **record-readable and gauge-invariant implies colour-blind**, and what remains readable of a colour source is *that* it is there, through triality, never *which* colour it is.

2. **Triality registers, and it is all that registers of a colour source.** `omega^{Q_v}` is in `R n I`; the Gauss sector sits exactly at triality zero; every colour octet, triplet and anti-triplet has a zero Gauss-sector block; and colour-rotated states are maximally distinct in the raw records -- `TV = 1`, disjoint supports -- yet identical to `1.7e-16` in every record-readable and gauge-invariant statistic, over eight declared axes and five declared angles.

findings.title: The finite supplied model is not a physical nearest-neighbour Record realization

anchors.text: Those last two clauses are the whole engine of this note, exactly as they were for its `SU(2)` predecessor. They say that what a readout can return is a function of record content -- in operator terms, an element of the algebra `R` of operators diagonal in the record basis. They say nothing about gauge invariance; the gauge law is a separate, declared structure. The question is what survives when both demands are made at once, now with three colours rather than two.

The lattice is physical. Everything below sits on small finite sub-graphs of it and adds two designed roles. Composition is **ordinary** throughout: the algebra of a region is the tensor product of its sites' algebras, with no graded clause anywhere.

The **carriers** are the **dimer** (corners `v = 0,1`, link `e = (i = 0, j = 1)`), the open **3-chain** (corners `0,1,2`, links `(0,1)` and `(1,2)`) and the **triangle** (corners `0,1,2`, links `(0,1)`, `(1,2)`, `(2,0)`). The **triplet role** is three encoded modes per corner, the layer index being the internal ("colour") label; the **link role** is one further six-dimensional site per link, `TWO DESIGNED RECORDS` -- an **orientation record** saying which end holds the rishon, and a **colour record**. Both are assigned by design and neither is derived from any axiom.

A **record pattern** is one assignment of a value to every record site: `3V` fermion records and `2E` link records, so `2^{3V} (2N)^E` of them -- `384` on the dimer, `18432` on the 3-chain, `110592` on the triangle -- and the **record basis** is the joint eigenbasis of the `Z`'s. An operator is **record-readable** when it is diagonal in that basis, so that its value is fixed by record content alone. `T^8` spans the same Cartan direction as `lambda^8/2`, so `I` is unchanged by the rescale, every generator entry is a dyadic rational of magnitude `<= 4`, and every `[exact]` zero test is `== 0`.

5. **Said plainly: this is confinement at the level of what can be registered**, now with the `Z_3` centre and a carrier that holds the `epsilon_abc` baryon -- a **kinematic** statement about readability under the Record axiom, holding before any dynamics is written. It is **not** a string tension, **not** an area law, and **not** dynamical confinement: no Hamiltonian is minimised anywhere in it.

Both roles are **designed**: the fermion triplet is a third code layer with an internal colour label, and the link is the truncated one-rishon quantum link, six-dimensional, two designed records, with `U_e` not unitary. Neither is derived from any axiom. **No unitary holonomy exists on this carrier**: `U U = 0`, so "the centre element of the link holonomy" is not available here and triality is registered through `omega^{Q_v}` only.

findings.title: The scaling/extrapolation explanations assert unsupported or false general laws

anchors.text: **Conclusion.** (1) For a diagonal `D`, `[D, G]_{rs} = (d_r - d_s) G_{rs}`, and `G_v^3, G_v^8` are themselves diagonal and impose nothing, so `R n I` is the algebra of functions **constant on the connected components** of the graph cut by the off-diagonal support of the six non-Cartan `G_v^a` -- `3840` edges on the dimer. There `dim(R n I) = 32 = 4^2 x 2` of `dim R = 384`, against `18 = 3^2 x 2` of `64` for `SU(2)` and `8 = 8` for `U(1)` on the identical geometry. (2) **`dim(R n I) = (N+1)^V x 2^E` exactly**, by explicit connected components on all nine carriers (three geometries `x N = 1,2,3`), equal every time both to the number of joint level sets of the abelian record data `(n^f_v ; o_e)` and to the number of joint level sets of `{Q_v} u {E^2_{e,end}}`; every off-diagonal entry of every non-Cartan `G_v^a` joins two patterns in the **same** level set, so no finer readable invariant exists. The law reproduces the parent's `1296 = 3^4 x 2^4` for the `SU(2)` plaquette and gives **`4096 = 4^4 x 2^4`** for the `SU(3)` plaquette. (3) `{Q_v} u {E^2_{e,end}}` have `32` joint level sets and so **generate all of `R n I`**, while `{Q_v}` alone gives `23`, `{E^2}` alone `2`, and triality `{Q_v mod 3}` alone `9`; on the one-rishon link `E^2_{e,end} = (4/3) P_end` exactly, matched to `2.2e-16` by `sum_a (E^a)^2`. Five declared component projectors, every `Q_v` and every `E^2_{e,end}` commute with all sixteen `G_v^a` at `nnz = 0`. (4) **Not one of the six single colour record values** -- the three matter colour occupations `n_{0,a}` and the three link colour records -- is in `I`; nor is the projector onto a single record pattern, so `R` is not contained in `I`; and only `8` record-value monomials lie in `R n I` against `dim(R n I) = 32`, so `R n I` is **not** spanned by record-value monomials. (5) All `32` component projectors commute with all sixteen `G_v^a`, checked at once by `LABELS[r] == LABELS[c]` over every one of the `3840` off-diagonal entries, so `U_g (R n I) U_g^dag = R n I`: redeclaring the colour record frame changes `R`, not `R n I`. (6) The dimer Gauss sector is `4`-dimensional, **`0` of the `384` record patterns solve the `SU(3)` Gauss law**, and `R n I` restricted to the sector is a complete commuting set -- record hull `12` patterns meeting `4` of the `32` readable classes, each an orthogonal projector of rank exactly one. (7) Exact-integer `SU(N)` Haar characters, a Weyl/Dyson constant term with no floating-point step, give Gauss dimension and `dim I` on every geometry including the plaquette: `SU(3)` dimer `4 / 146`, 3-chain `10 / 4692`, triangle `14 / 31412`, plaquette **`34 / 991584`**; and the same machinery **reproduces the parent's `dim I = 356306` and Gauss dimension `82`** on the `SU(2)` plaquette by an independent route. (8) On the 3-chain, `dim H = 18432` and `dim(R n I) = 256 = 4^3 x 2^2`: the Gauss sector is `10`-dimensional, matching the character count; `0` record patterns solve the Gauss law; and `R n I` restricted to it is again a complete commuting set -- hull `78` patterns meeting `10` of the `256` readable classes, all rank one.

**Conclusion.** (1) The readable fraction of the **gauge-invariant** algebra is **not monotone in `N`**. `dim(R n I)/dim I` is *larger* for `SU(3)` than for `SU(2)` on every geometry computed: plaquette `4.131e-3` against `3.637e-3`, dimer `2.192e-1` against `1.957e-1`, 3-chain `5.456e-2` against `4.751e-2`, triangle `1.630e-2` against `1.481e-2`. The reason is arithmetic: `(N+1)^V 2^E` grows polynomially in `N` while `dim I` is throttled by the tightening singlet constraint, `SU(3)` admitting an irrep only when `p - q = 0 mod 3`. By contrast the readable fraction of `R` **does** fall monotonically -- on the plaquette `1` for `U(1)`, `0.019775` for `SU(2)`, `0.000772` for `SU(3)`. The same non-monotonicity appears in the Gauss dimension itself: the `SU(3)` plaquette's `34` is *smaller* than the `SU(2)` plaquette's `82`, triality-zero being a stronger constraint than `Z_2` parity. (2) The general pattern is **centre and `u(1)`-charge data**, not centre and Cartan. Both Cartan generators `G_v^3` and `G_v^8` are record-diagonal -- zero off-diagonal entries, so in `R` -- and **not** in `I`, with identically vanishing Gauss-sector blocks, `max = 1.1e-31`. The frame-dependent record readout `2 <rho_0^3>`, in `R` and not in `I`, reports `(0.2, -0.2, 0.0, 0.152968437)` on the four triplet states: it separates them, which is exactly why it is not a physical readout.

- **Adjoint matter.** For matter in the adjoint, triality is trivial and the "centre registers" statement of Theorem 3 **empties out**: the confinement story would then have to be told entirely through singlets. No adjoint object is built here, and nothing above decides that case.

- **Larger rishon sectors.** Only `N_e = 1` is computed, where `E^2_{e,end} = (4/3) P_end` is degenerate. With `N_e > 1` the link-end Casimir takes more values and `R n I` would be strictly larger -- still abelian, but the `(N+1)^V 2^E` count would change. Untested.

**Only the one-rishon link sector.** `E^2_{e,end} = (4/3) P_end` is degenerate there, so the link-end Casimir carries no more than the orientation record. With `N_e > 1` the Casimir would take more values and `R n I` would be strictly larger -- still abelian, but the `(N+1)^V 2^E` count would change. Untested.
